_note: Step-1 decisions. Everything is SYNTHETIC unless origin says otherwise; gen_fixtures labels every record. Replace gene/claim/effects here — nothing else needs editing.
claim: TYK2 mRNA abundance is higher in IL-23-stimulated primary human keratinocytes than in vehicle-treated controls (treated vs control, 24 h). Question: does this directional increase in TYK2 mRNA also hold (a) in mouse imiquimod-induced psoriasiform skin vs vehicle skin, (b) in lesional vs non-lesional skin of psoriasis patients at the mRNA level, and (c) at the protein level within the same patients?

axes.question: Does TYK2/Tyk2 mRNA change in the same direction in mouse imiquimod psoriasiform skin (IMQ vs vehicle) as in the in-vitro contrast? Declare the alignment basis (both are inflammatory psoriasis-like stimulation of keratinocyte-rich tissue) or mark not_assessable.
Does TYK2 mRNA change in the same direction in patient lesional vs non-lesional skin as in the in-vitro contrast?

WITHIN THE SAME PARTICIPANTS, is the patient mRNA increase accompanied by a TYK2 protein increase (lesional vs non-lesional)? This axis requires overlapping participant_ids; without them it is not_assessable — independent-cohort agreement is a different, weaker statement and must be labelled as such.

checklist: Read the in-vitro origin observation and note gene, endpoint, contrast, direction.
For each axis, read the counterpart observation(s); if a required dataset is `unavailable`, apply the retry policy (fetch_dataset once) before deciding the axis.
For each axis, state the contrast alignment basis explicitly; if none can be stated, the axis is not_assessable.
For the within-person axis, verify participant_id overlap between the two patient datasets; specimen_id and timepoint are not participant identity.

Interpret reference-source statuses structurally: not_found = database has no record; error = technical, retryable; skipped = disabled by mode or upstream. Never read any of them as a biological negative.
Use GTEx reference abundance, orthology and IMPC phenotypes as background only; they are not disease-contrast observations and do not decide an axis.
Cite every observation_id or reference key an axis verdict rests on; do not cite what you did not use.
Overall verdict must be consistent with the axes: any axis diverges → overall cannot be persists; an axis not_assessable → say so in caveats.

invitro.model: primary human epidermal keratinocytes, pooled 3 donors

invivo.model: C57BL/6J, imiquimod 5% cream 62.5 mg/day x 6 days, dorsal skin
invivo.alignment_basis: IMQ psoriasiform inflammation vs vehicle is the standard murine model of the IL-23/IL-17 axis engaged by the in-vitro IL-23 stimulation; endpoint is the same (mRNA abundance) in keratinocyte-rich tissue

patient_rna.cohort: 12 adults with plaque psoriasis, paired lesional/non-lesional 4 mm punch biopsies, baseline visit

patient_prot.cohort: 12 adults with plaque psoriasis, paired lesional/non-lesional 4 mm punch biopsies, baseline visit

_limits_note: Same limits for every system. A corpus of ~24 files needs ~15 reads to process fully; 90 s was infeasible for a whole-system run that plans, collects, extracts and checks — measured on the calibration case (handoff §6: reduce scope for BOTH systems before freezing, never after seeing scores).
